summary: Toyota Motor Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing a decision to execute a simplified absorption-type company split, transferring its logistics optimization system business (OneStream) to wholly owned subsidiary OneStream Co., Ltd. The split is expected to close on June 29, 2026, with no consideration as it is a restructuring between parent and sub. Toyota plans to subsequently sell 30% of OneStream shares to third parties around mid-June 2026. No board recommendation or advisor named. The split qualifies as a simplified split as the asset change is under 10% of net assets. Watch for completion of the share transfer and impact on logistics operations.
